name: @comm/storage
description: Object storage abstraction for the file-attachment pipeline (docs/13-roadmap.md) — a local-filesystem dev-default adapter plus a real S3-compatible production adapter behind one interface. Shared by apps/web (upload/download routes) and apps/worker (the orphaned-object cleanup sweep) — same reasoning as @comm/security's createRedisSubscriber: two apps needing the identical implementation is what earns something a place in packages/*, not apps/web alone.
